sn22.8:1.5: Idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano Rūpam etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassati ||
sn22.8:1.6: Tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.8:1.11: Viññāṇam etam mama esoham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassati ||
sn22.8:1.12: tassa taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.8:2.1: Kathaṃ ca bhikkhave anupādā aparitassanā hoti || || 11
sn22.8:2.2: Idha bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako Rūpaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti samanupassati || ||
sn22.8:2.3: Tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.8:2.8: Viññāṇaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti samanupassati ||
sn22.8:2.9: tassa taṃ viññāṇam vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
